fields.lordemannd\n\n 2024-02-01 17:32\n\ndevel:
Thanks to @SNoiraud, Issue # 2 is explained:
When Gramps is configured to use German for the User Interface, Gramps allows many Old German & Latin names and abbreviations in parsing dates.
month_to_int["erntemond"] = 8 == harvest moon meaning the month of August
month_to_int["bisemond"] = 8 == alternate for harvest moon
month_to_int["holzing"] = 9 == alternate for holzmond, the wood moon meaning the month of September.

this allows the entry of the date related words directly from old documents.
